retainedExperiment.note: Same website task, same five retained Pipe sources, same managed Codex account and requested gpt-6.1-sol low. Baseline versus guided method changes developer instructions and design-rules MCP. Guided output keeps the project H1 but adds the shared heading and dark/yellow palette alongside project green. Select hello-search/baseline for this isolated project to keep its reference design simpler; this is an explicit project choice, not evidence of general quality superiority. Native observed windows and receipt duration are separate: guided terminal receipt includes manual closure-event outbox sequence reconciliation, with no model replay. The native binary also gained lifecycle observation; do not read receipt delay as model latency.
